leakage_audit.labels: WIN/LOSS in own POV replay filename only; outcomes never inputs
leakage_audit.result_features: DefaultObservationSpace.state_to_obs never reads battle_won or battle_lost; no end-of-battle token
leakage_audit.turn_bucket_semantics: Zero-based decision index, including forced switches; UniversalState does not retain simulator turn number
leakage_audit.last_state: Final observed pre-action state may be strategically decisive; not terminal result. See final_step accuracy and Brier per run.
leakage_audit.turn0_investigation: Compare first_step metrics against rating-only baseline; ratings are reference labels, not model features. Initial species/HP/moves are legitimate public inputs.
leakage_audit.outcome_alignment: datasets/w4/outcomes.json includes ordered filename POVs, NPZ alignment evidence and trajectory digests

final_observation_terminal_hp_check.method: Own active HP + positive available-switch HP; opponents_remaining
final_observation_terminal_hp_check.interpretation: Only checks explicit terminal HP counts, not tactical inevitability. See final-step model accuracy separately.

selection_reason: Joint eligible only if W4 val policy loss <= v1 + 0.01; among eligible runs choose lowest W4 val Brier. Selected probe.
paired_battle_impact: Deferred to W4.5; no win-rate improvement claim

live_smoke.interpretation: Live Brier on 20 battles only; sanity check, not a policy-quality or win-rate claim
